name: @satoramoto/use-resize-observer-shim
description: The use-resize-observer hook with a default export, for mafs 0.21 under React 19. Not installed: every Vite config here aliases the bare 'use-resize-observer' import to index.js (vite.aliases.ts), while npm installs use-resize-observer 10 through package.json overrides so the install itself is clean.
